text: The world's biggest lake is called a sea. The Caspian covers about 370,000 square kilometers,
bigger than Germany. It holds about 40% of all the lake water on Earth.
It's salty, but only a third as salty as the ocean. And its surface sits about 28 meters below
sea level. Five countries share it. Russia, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Iran, and Azerbaijan.
John. So am I a sea fish or a lake fish? With oil and gas underneath, that question was
worth billions. A sea gets split by maritime law. A lake gets split between its shores.
After more than 20 years of talks, the five signed a deal in 2018 and called it neither.
Meanwhile, it's shrinking. In 2025, it hit its lowest level ever recorded. Sea, lake,
just don't make it a puddle.
